Our Celebration

A Celebration of Love & Faith

Our reception will be a simple, intimate, and a relaxed celebration shared with our closest family and friends. With no formal program, we hope everyone can simply enjoy good food, share meaningful conversations and laughter, and cherish this special time together.

Above all, this wedding is a celebration of God’s love and faithfulness. We give this beautiful day back to Him, giving Him all the glory and honoring Him as the center of our marriage and our lives together. It is our heartfelt joy to celebrate this intimate beginning with the people we love and cherish most.
